title: Eggbound
description: Turns the Dragon Egg into a powerful cursed relic.
body:
first release of Eggbound.

This version turns the Dragon Egg into a cursed relic instead of just a trophy.
Egg Bearer powers when carrying the Dragon Egg
Stronger Egg powers inside The End
Glowing effect so the Egg Bearer can be hunted
Dropped Dragon Egg glow
Dropped Dragon Egg no-despawn behavior
Dropped Dragon Egg item protection
Void rescue that sends the Egg back to the End fountain
Outside The End, the Egg grants Speed I, Strength I, Regeneration I, and Glowing.
Inside The End, the Egg grants Speed II, Strength II, Health Boost V, and Glowing.
This version focuses on carrying and dropping the Egg. Placed Egg block protection may be added later. (no longer cuases lag)
